title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 08
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas-free certificate' is issued when
options: A verbal assurance given by the pump man of the mine
A written declaration that is given by the mine surveyor of the mine
Whenever the mine manager of this mine happens to be absent
A competent person certifies the area is free from hazardous gases
questions.solution: When a competent person certifies the area is gas-free.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'brattice' in underground mines is used to
options: The storing of the materials in the mine
The carrying of the weight of the roof
The providing of the lighting in the mine
Direct airflow by temporary partition
questions.solution: Brattice is a temporary partition to direct airflow.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing operations' must be coordinated with
options: Only with the surface workshops of the mine
No any coordination at all is needed
Mining operations for safety and efficiency
Only with the accounts department
questions.solution: Stowing must coordinate with mining operations for safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'carbon dioxide' (CO2) in mines can cause
options: No any effect at all on the human body
A refreshing cooling sensation
Suffocation at high concentrations
The improvement of the breathing of men
questions.solution: CO2 causes suffocation at high concentrations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cut shot' in coal mines is fired to
options: Create a free face for subsequent shots
The widening of the mine gallery
The strengthening of the mine roof
The breaking of the coal face only
questions.solution: Cut shots create a free face for subsequent production shots.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per DGMS Circular 2/2010, strata and dump slope monitoring is mandatory for dumps exceeding ______ in height.
questions.solution: DGMS Circular 2/2010: monitoring (including slope stability radar / real-time monitoring) is made mandatory for dumps exceeding 60 m height.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'night operations' safety requires
options: Adequate lighting, signage, reduced speeds
No any special measures at all are needed
Restricting haulage to the upper benches
The halting of all the movement after dark
questions.solution: Night operations need lighting, signage, speed controls.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'calorific value' of coal is measured in
options: Kilocalories per kilogram or BTU per pound
The kilograms of coal per cubic metre
The litres of water per tonne of coal
The metres of air per second of flow
questions.solution: Calorific value is measured in kcal/kg or BTU/lb.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: DGMS (Tech.) (S&T) Circular No. 02 of 2010 deals with:
options: The detailed shaft sinking procedures that are followed in mine
The detailed planning of the ventilation systems of the whole mining area
The use of the diesel equipment that is fitted belowground
Design, control and monitoring of pit and dump slopes in opencast mines
questions.solution: DGMS (Tech.) (S&T) Circular No. 02 dated 06.07.2010 concerns design, control and monitoring of pit and dump slopes in opencast mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coalfield' is an area with
options: A single continuous seam throughout
Multiple coal seams and deposits
A single thin coal seam only
An igneous intrusion in the rock only
questions.solution: A coalfield has multiple coal seams and deposits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'fault' in geological terms is
options: A fracture in the rock along which displacement has occurred
A fold that is formed in the sedimentary rock strata of mines
An intrusion of the molten magma into the rock mass
A washout that is filled with the sandy sediments
questions.solution: A fracture with displacement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'over-manometer' is used to measure
options: Only the measurement of the voltage of the circuit
The humidity of the return air in the mine workings
Only the velocity of the air in the mine roadways of that area
Ventilation pressure across stoppings, doors, or regulators
questions.solution: Ventilation pressure across stoppings, doors, or regulators.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding engine house must be
options: Fireproof and properly ventilated
Built underground near the shaft
Built of temporary materials
Any building near the pit top
questions.solution: Fireproof and properly ventilated construction is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Anthracite is the highest rank of coal because it has
options: The highest moisture content in the coal
The least calorific value of the coal
Most carbon content and least moisture
The least carbon content of the coal
questions.solution: Anthracite has highest carbon content and least moisture.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An accident investigation team should include
options: Only the officers of the mine and of the mining company
Competent persons including safety officer and workers' representative
The reduction of the maintenance of all the mine equipment of the mine
Only the representatives of the owner of the mining company
questions.solution: Competent persons including safety officer and workers' representative.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The brake of a winding engine must be tested
options: Never in the mine
Once in a year
Before each shift
Only on rope change
questions.solution: Testing before each shift is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'competent person' is defined as
options: A person holding a valid certificate of competency
A person with more than ten years of service
A person nominated by the workers' union
Any worker of the mine mining department
questions.solution: A person holding a valid certificate of competency.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire prevention measures' in a mine include
options: The painting of the mine machinery once in a year
Proper housekeeping, electrical safety, and prohibiting smoking
The storing of the oily rags near the working faces of the mine workings
The washing of the haul roads of the mine each day
questions.solution: Proper housekeeping, electrical safety, and prohibiting smoking.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A rescue-trained person shall practise with breathing apparatus at least:
options: 8 times a year, of which 4 in mines
Once in every month of the year
The practice of 12 times a year
4 times a year, of which 2 in mines
questions.solution: MRR 1985: rescue-trained persons practise with breathing apparatus at least 8 times a year, including 4 practices in the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'panel layout' in longwall mining includes
options: Gate roads, face, and connecting roadways
Only the layout of the surface fan house
Only the layout of the mine pit bottom
The layout of the railway siding of the mine
questions.solution: Gate roads, face, and connecting roadways.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire detection system' in mines includes
options: No detection of the fire at all is needed
Only a manual patrol by the watchman
A single alarm bell at the pit head
Smoke detectors, heat sensors, and gas monitors
questions.solution: Detection systems include smoke detectors, heat sensors, gas monitors.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An intrinsic safety barrier is used to
options: Limit energy to safe levels in intrinsically safe circuits
The reduction of the equipment maintenance work
The increase of the ventilation in the district
The separation of the circuit from the mine battery supply unit
questions.solution: Limits energy to safe levels in IS circuits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'misfire' must be dealt with by
options: Any worker that is present at the mine face
Re-drilling the hole immediately after firing
A competent person following prescribed procedures
The waiting for the next production shift of mine
questions.solution: By a competent person following procedures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Rescue Rules 1985, the breathing apparatus kept at a rescue station or rescue room shall:
options: Be of the same type and make
Be of different types for flexibility
The apparatus that are imported only
Be replaced every month
questions.solution: MRR 1985, Rule 11(4): breathing apparatus at a rescue station/room must be of the same type and make for interchangeability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'section' in mine surveying shows
options: The horizontal projection of the mine workings
The record of the temperature variations of mine
The vertical projection of workings along a vertical plane
The tonnage of the coal shown at only one place on the plan of mine
questions.solution: The vertical projection along a vertical plane.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blasting safety zone' radius depends on
options: The time of day at which blasting is done
Fixed at 25 m in every mine
Type and quantity of explosives used
The diameter of the drill rod
questions.solution: Safety zone radius depends on explosive type and quantity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blasting circuit' must be checked for
options: Loose connections found only after the shot
Continuity checked only during charging
Continuity and proper connections before firing
The adequacy of the roof support in the drift
questions.solution: Continuity and proper connections.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must not be used during
options: During the day shift that is worked in the mine working section
During the night shift that is worked in the mine
Blasting operations until all persons are at safe distance
During the normal operations of the mine workings
questions.solution: Must not be used during blasting until safe.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team fitness' must be
options: Physically fit and medically cleared for rescue operations
Being able to run a long marathon course of the mining area here
The average level of physical fitness is enough
Any level of the physical fitness of the person
questions.solution: Teams must be physically fit and medically cleared.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine surveyor' is responsible for
options: The selection of the rating of the ventilation fan
The determination of the blast hole firing pattern
The appointment of the competent persons of the mine working sections
Accurate survey of workings, preparation of plans and sections
questions.solution: Accurate survey, preparation of plans and sections.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'crack monitoring' on highwalls involves
options: A single inspection at the start of the year
Only the weekly photographic inspection of it
Regular measurement of crack width, length, movement
Estimating the crack depth by hammer tapping
questions.solution: Crack monitoring measures parameters for early warning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The water pump house must be located at
options: Only at the underground of the mine workings
At the residence of the mine manager of mine
A convenient place accessible for maintenance and operation
Any place that is away from the mine water sump of the open pit
questions.solution: A convenient accessible place.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'lost time injury frequency rate' (LTIFR) measures
options: Number of lost time injuries per million man-hours worked
The number of days for which the mine remains closed
Only the current measurement of the injuries
The rate of the production of the coal mine working sections
questions.solution: Number of lost time injuries per million man-hours worked.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'sealed area' in a mine fire is created to
options: To improve the haulage cycle of the mine
To supply the fresh air to the fire area
Isolate the fire area and deprive it of oxygen
To increase the ventilation of the mine
questions.solution: Isolates fire area and deprives it of oxygen.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must not be overloaded beyond
options: 20% of capacity
The rated capacity
10% of capacity
Any limit
questions.solution: Must not be overloaded beyond rated capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire safety training' for miners includes
options: Only the underground fire fighting plan of mine
Only the use of the portable fire extinguishers
No any training of the fire is needed at all
Fire prevention, detection, and evacuation procedures
questions.solution: Training covers prevention, detection, evacuation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'geological disturbance' in coal seams includes
options: Rolls and cleats in the coal seam
No any disturbance in the coal seams
Faults, folds, intrusions, and washouts
Bedding planes in the overburden
questions.solution: Geological disturbances include faults, folds, intrusions, washouts.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water dam height' must be sufficient to
options: Any height that is convenient to the mine
Equal to the depth of the shaft
Equal to the height of the winding tower
Withstand maximum expected water pressure
questions.solution: Dam height must withstand maximum expected water pressure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rock dusting' in coal mines is done to
options: Increase the incombustible content of the seam
The wetting of the roadway before each shift
Prevent coal dust explosion by making dust inert
The increase of the ventilation fan speed
questions.solution: Rock dusting inertizes coal dust to prevent explosions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support cycle' in longwall mining includes
options: The supporting of the conveyor belts of mine
Setting, advancing, and releasing of powered supports
The painting of the powered roof supports
The control of the dust emissions in mine
questions.solution: Setting, advancing, and releasing of powered supports.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The lower explosive limit of coal dust in air is approximately
options: 200 g/m³
100 g/m³
50 g/m³
500 g/m³
questions.solution: The lower explosive limit is approximately 100 g/m³.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The delay sequence in blasting is designed to
options: Optimize fragmentation and control vibration
Detonate all holes simultaneously
The reduction of the cost of blasting
The increase of the flyrock of the blast
questions.solution: Delay sequences optimize fragmentation and minimize vibration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ash content' in coal affects
options: Combustion efficiency and disposal requirements
The grain size of coal washed out of the seam
The colour of the seam floor workings
The number of persons engaged at the face
questions.solution: Ash content affects combustion efficiency and disposal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air velocity' in mine roadways should be
options: The same in every roadway of the mine
Zero in all the roadways of the mine
Sufficient to dilute and remove contaminants
As high as it is possible in the mine
questions.solution: Air velocity must be sufficient to dilute contaminants.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The water level in the sump must be monitored by
options: The measuring of the air velocity in mine
The manager of the mine working alone
The person in charge of pumping arrangements
No one unless a pump is installed
questions.solution: By the person in charge of pumping arrangements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'methane emission' from coal seams is related to
options: The presence of faults within the seam
The thickness of the overburden cover
Coal rank, depth, and gas content
The method of mechanised coal cutting
questions.solution: Methane emission relates to rank, depth, and gas content.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A haulage rope in a mine is used for
options: Hauling coal tubs or cars from face to siding
The cutting of the coal at the mine face
The supporting of the roof in the headings
Transporting persons on a conveyor belt
questions.solution: Hauls coal tubs or cars from face to siding.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation training' for miners includes
options: The study of the production figures of the coal mine sections
No any such training at all is needed in mine
Understanding airflow, gas hazards, and emergency procedures
The provision of the fresh air to working faces
questions.solution: Training covers airflow, gas hazards, emergency procedures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sulfur content' in coal is important because
options: It improves the coking property of all coals
It is fixed for all the coals of the mines
It causes pollution and corrosion during combustion
It reduces the moisture that is in the coal
questions.solution: Sulfur causes pollution and corrosion during combustion.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'mine rescue team' must be trained in accordance with
options: Only the internal policy
Mines Rescue Rules 1985
No any regulations at all
The Factories Act only
questions.solution: Mines Rescue Rules 1985.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the route of travel
options: Passes through the store room
The route that has no lighting
The route that is underground only
Is safe and properly maintained
questions.solution: Routes of travel must be safe and properly maintained.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum anchorage strength of roof bolts depends on
options: The protection of the electrical equipment
Roof conditions, bolt type, and depth of installation
A single value that is fixed for every mine
The prevention of the water ingress in the mine workings
questions.solution: Anchorage strength depends on conditions, bolt type, and depth.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The stage loader transfers coal from
options: The surface bunker to the rail siding
The main gate of the mine to the workshop
The AFC to the belt conveyor at the gate end
The coal store of the mine to the washery
questions.solution: Transfers coal from AFC to belt conveyor at the gate end.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'demolition report' must include
options: The names of the mine workers that are present in that working area
The colour of the machinery that has been used in that area
The weather forecast of the surrounding mining area daily
Area demolished, method used, safety measures, and disposal of material
questions.solution: Area, method, safety measures, and disposal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A rescue room is required at a mine where the number of persons employed belowground exceeds 100 and:
options: The mine produces less than 100 tonnes a day
There is no supply of the electricity
There is no rescue station within 35 km
The mine in question is opencast only
questions.solution: MRR 1985: a rescue room is required when more than 100 persons work belowground and no rescue station is within 35 km.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main switchboard in a mine must have
options: Clear labeling, single-line diagram, and metering facilities
It is installed at the surface of the mine shaft portal area only
It is rated for the voltage of the mine circuit only
It has no any special feature fitted in the panel
questions.solution: Clear labeling, single-line diagram, and metering facilities.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'GPS' in mine surveying is used for
options: The detection of the firedamp in the return airway of the mine workings
The reduction of the levels below the coal seam of mine
The direct measurement of the roof bolt depth in mine
Surface control surveys and establishing survey control points
questions.solution: Surface control surveys and establishing control points.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Behavioral-based safety (BBS) focuses on
options: The repair and upkeep of the mine machinery there
Safe behaviors of workers through observation and feedback
The maintenance and upkeep of the mine equipment
The design and layout of the ventilation plan of the mine area
questions.solution: Safe behaviors through observation and feedback.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'underground survey' extends
options: Surface control into underground workings
The monitoring of the gas concentrations
It is not related to the surface work
The survey of the mine surface only
questions.solution: Underground surveys extend surface control underground.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gas chromatography' in mines is used to
options: Estimate the tonnage of the seam
Measure the temperature of the strata
Identify and measure gas composition
The analysis of the quality of the coal
questions.solution: Gas chromatography identifies and measures gas composition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Permissible explosives in coal mines must not
options: Be stored with detonators in the same magazine
Be fired without any shot firer being present in the mine workings
Cause ignition of methane or coal dust under test conditions
Be used in the same blasting round as the cut holes
questions.solution: Must not cause ignition of methane or coal dust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drill water' in drifting serves to
options: Cool the drill bit and suppress dust
The lubrication of the haulage rope of mine
Flush the cuttings out of the hole
Increase the penetration rate of the drill
questions.solution: Drill water cools the bit and suppresses dust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per the Mines Rescue Rules 1985, a rescue station shall be under the charge of a Superintendent assisted by at least:
options: 2 instructors and a rescue brigade of at least 18 rescue-trained persons
1 instructor and a rescue brigade of at least the 10 persons in mine
4 instructors and a rescue brigade of at least 50 persons
1 officer and a rescue brigade of at least 5 mine persons
questions.solution: MRR 1985: a rescue station has a Superintendent, at least 2 instructors and a rescue brigade of at least 18 rescue-trained persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mechanized mining' achieves higher productivity because of
options: The replacement of all the mine development work
Use of continuous miners, loaders, and conveyor systems
The elimination of all the mine development work
The use of only the hand tools at the mine working sections
questions.solution: Use of continuous miners, loaders, and conveyors.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the manager is responsible for
options: The issuing of the blasting permits only
Overall management and safety of the mine
The preparing of the monthly pay roll of mine
Conducting the vocational training classes
questions.solution: Overall management and safety of the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'signature' of the sirdar on a report
options: It is not needed at all in the mine report
The use of the informal language in the report
It is required only once in every calendar month
Certifies that the report is accurate and complete
questions.solution: Certifies that the report is accurate and complete.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water inflow rate' in a mine is measured in
options: Only the measurement of the voltage of the circuit
Only the liters of the inflow per day
Liters per minute or cubic meters per hour
The kilograms per square metre of the area
questions.solution: Liters per minute or cubic meters per hour.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A road header in mining is used to
options: Excavate rock and coal mechanically
The loading of the coal into the dumpers
Benching the overburden in a pit
Drilling vertical blast holes
questions.solution: Excavates rock and coal mechanically.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'tail gate' in longwall mining is the
options: Roadway at the intake end of the longwall face
The cross-cut connecting two longwall gates
Roadway at the return end of the longwall face
The gate road developed outbye the panel
questions.solution: Roadway at return end of face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The certificate of fitness for a person working in a mine must be issued by
options: The contractor of the mine
Only the manager of the mine
A qualified medical practitioner
The sirdar of the section
questions.solution: A qualified medical practitioner.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'factor of safety' for support design is typically
questions.solution: Factor of safety for support is typically 1.5-2.5.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal burst' in deep mines occurs when
options: Absence of stress in the coal seam
The coal is under no pressure
Rapid removal of the overburden
Sudden release of stress energy in coal
questions.solution: Coal bursts are sudden stress energy releases.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'underbreak' in drifting refers to
options: Failure to excavate to the planned perimeter
The excess water inflow in the drift
The over-excavation of the coal seams
The rapid advance of the mine drift
questions.solution: Failure to excavate to the planned perimeter.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'welfare officer' in a mine must be appointed when the number of workers exceeds
questions.solution: When the number of workers exceeds 200.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'rescue station register' must record
options: The daily production figures of the mine given daily
The list of the explosives that are stored in the mining area here
Details of all rescue operations, team members, and equipment used
The attendance of the surface workers of the mining areas
questions.solution: Details of all operations, team members, and equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety observation' is a tool used to
options: Observe and feedback on safe and unsafe behaviors
The measuring of the output of each shift
Rank the safety performance of each section
Record the tonnage of coal despatched
questions.solution: Observe and feedback on safe and unsafe behaviors.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'fire extinguisher' in a mine must be of the type suitable for
options: The class of fire likely to occur in that area
The brand of the fire extinguisher used
The colour of the fire extinguishers in the mine
Any fire that may occur in the whole mine
questions.solution: The class of fire likely to occur in that area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety lamp room' in a mine must be under the control of
options: Any person who is employed in the mine
The ventilation officer of the mine
A competent person authorized by the manager
The shift supervisor of the opencast mine
questions.solution: A competent person authorized by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bolt length' in roof support typically ranges from
options: 3-4 meters
5+ meters
1.2-2.4 meters
0.5 meter
questions.solution: Typical bolt lengths range from 1.2-2.4 meters.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The frequency of gravimetric sampling is determined by
options: The manager based on conditions
The workers' representatives
The contractor of the mine
Only the inspector of the mines
questions.solution: The manager determines based on conditions.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'INS Vikrant' is India's
options: First indigenous aircraft carrier
The first nuclear submarine of the nation
The first ballistic missile of the nation
The first destroyer of the Indian navy
questions.solution: First indigenous aircraft carrier.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The ratio of the circumference to the diameter of a circle is
options: 4π
π
2π
questions.solution: C/d = π.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'strip mining' method involves
options: Removing overburden to access shallow coal deposits
The extraction of the coal from the deep coal seams
The removal of the waste from the surface coal mine
Drilling of vertical shafts for access
questions.solution: Strip mining removes overburden for shallow deposits.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Forest Clearance' for mining is required under
options: The Mines Act 1952 alone
Forest Conservation Act 1980
The Land Acquisition Act 1894 alone
The Contract Act 1872
questions.solution: Required under Forest Conservation Act 1980.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The first General Elections in India were held in
questions.solution: First general elections were held in 1951-52.

questions.stem: A shopkeeper buys an article for ₹400 and sells it for ₹500. Profit is

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The headquarters of the Indian Railways is in
options: New Delhi
Chennai
Mumbai
Kolkata
questions.solution: Railway Board headquarters is in New Delhi.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The first Chief Justice of India was
options: S.R. Das
Harilal Jekisundas Kania
M. Patanjali Sastri
B.K. Mukherjea
questions.solution: H.J. Kania was the first CJI.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'fatal accident rate' in Indian coal mines has been
options: Unchanged over the last two decades
Steadily increasing in recent years
Gradually decreasing over the years
Constant throughout the years
questions.solution: Gradually decreasing over the years.

questions.subject: General
questions.solution: LCM=48.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A bar chart shows fuel consumption: Diesel=200, Petrol=50, Electricity=300. Total energy consumption?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The average of 5 numbers is 20. If one number is removed, the average becomes 18. What is the removed number?
questions.solution: Total = 100, new total = 72, removed = 28.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'first mile connectivity' project of CIL involves
options: Connecting coal mines to rail sidings for efficient transport
A housing scheme for the coal mine workers here
A recruitment drive for the mining engineers of mines
A subsidy scheme for the imports of coal in the country today
questions.solution: Connecting mines to rail sidings.

questions.stem: If 30% of x = 75, x=?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Gobi Desert is located in
options: China and Mongolia
Africa
Australia
India and Pakistan
questions.solution: Gobi Desert spans China and Mongolia.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The headquarters of WTO is in
options: London
Paris
New York
Geneva
questions.solution: WTO headquarters is in Geneva.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If the profit is 20% on cost price, what is the profit on selling price?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal production' in India is measured in
options: Kilograms
Million tonnes
Tons only
Quintals
questions.solution: Coal production is measured in million tonnes.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A is twice as old as B. 5 years ago A was 3 times B. How old is A?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: In a row of students, Rahul is 12th from the left and 18th from the right. How many students are in the row?
